description: Poll a previously submitted AEO report job once. status is queued, preparing, needs_review or running (keep polling) or complete, partial or failed (terminal); state carries the phase and reason. When complete or partial, returns the structured report (per-engine breakdown with provenance, recommendations, coverage, methodology, the measured questions, competitor evidence, named share of voice), the shareable report_url, and a markdown_summary to read to the user.
name: get_aeo_report_status
